createaddition.ponder.connector.text_1: The Alternator is a producer of energy...
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_2: ...while the Electric Motor is a consumer of energy
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_3: Producers need a connector in Pull mode, which pulls energy out of the block it is attached to
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_4: Consumers need a connector in Push mode, which pushes energy into the block it is attached to
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_5: Use a Wrench on a connector to cycle its mode
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_6: Connectors in None mode do not interact with the block they are attached to...
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_7: ...they only relay energy through their wires, so they can be placed on any block
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_8: Connect two connectors with a wire by right-clicking both using a Copper Spool
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_9: Energy now flows from the Alternator to the Electric Motor
createaddition.ponder.connector_remove.h: Removing Wires using an Empty Spool
createaddition.ponder.connector_remove.t: Right-click both ends of a wire with an Empty Spool to remove it
The wire is returned as a filled Spool
createaddition.ponder.electric_pump_flow: Electric Pumps govern the flow of their attached pipe networks
Their arrow indicates the direction of flow
The network behind is now pulling fluids...
...while the network in front is transferring it outward
A Wrench can be used to reverse the direction
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.header: Rotating Blocks to precise Angles using the Servo Motor
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_1: The Servo Motor uses redstone to rotate attached blocks to a precise angle
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_2: It requires a source of energy (fe) to operate
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_3: Redstone power on this side turns the Servo towards its Max Angle...
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_4: ...while power on the opposite side turns it towards its Min Angle
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_5: The signals from both sides are summed, with the Min side counting as negative, so equal signals cancel each other out
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_6: How far the Servo turns depends on the strength of the summed signal
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_7: Scroll on the sides of the Servo to adjust its Max and Min Angles between 0° and 180°
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_8: With the Max Angle raised to 180°, the same signal now turns it twice as far
